observation.task: You are auditing one fictional company for one reporting period. Find financial errors in the books and submit findings with evidence. Error types: duplicate_invoice (affected_ids=[invoice_id of the later copy]), payment_allocation (affected_ids=[payment_id]), fx_rate (affected_ids=[invoice_id or payment_id of the mis-converted document]), period_cutoff (affected_ids=[invoice_id]), vat_error (affected_ids=[invoice_id]; a 'VAT 12%' line must equal 12% of the other lines, half-even). claimed_amount_minor = absolute distortion in base currency minor units (tolerance: 1 minor unit); currency = base currency. For payment_allocation the amount is the part of the receipt left on Unapplied Cash (2400) instead of Accounts Receivable (1200), converted at the payment's policy rate (for a foreign-currency receipt this does not depend on the rate posted to Cash). evidence_ids may contain doc_id, ledger row_id, fx id (fx:DATE:SRC:TGT) and 'policy'. Clean books exist: submitting nothing can be correct. Tools: list_records(table, cursor, limit<=50), get_record(table, id), get_document(doc_id), calculator(expression), submit(findings={episode_id, findings:[{type, affected_ids, claimed_amount_minor, currency, evidence_ids, explanation}]}) - the flat form submit(episode_id, findings:[...]) is accepted too; a malformed submission ends the episode with reward -1. Budget: 100 steps including submit; every action, even an error, uses a step. Reward = clip(2*F1 - 1 - 0.002*inspection_steps, -1, 1).
